sources.citation: PHOIBLE 2.0, inventory GM 1529 'Alladian' (source cited: Duponchel 1974, L'Alladian: phonologie et enquête lexicale)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Lists two tonemes (high ˦, low ˨) plus segments; no statement about stress/accent.
en page: consonant/vowel charts from PHOIBLE, 'There are two tones. High tone and low tone.' No stress statement; fr page gives village list (Dumestre 1971) and bibliography only.
